newsitem.title: FRANCE: Matif to create euro interest rate products.
newsitem.headline: Matif to create euro interest rate products.

text.p: French financial futures and options exchange Matif said on Wednesday it aimed to create interest rate products across the yield curve based on the European single currency.
The Matif also said it would act now to reduce the coupon on its 10-year bond future contract to anchor the contract to the 10-year benchmark bond.
It said it would issue a separate statement detailing the reduction in the coupon on the notionel, now at 10 percent, compared to the current 10-year yield of 5.97 percent.
It said its board had met on Tuesday to decide the broad lines of its approach to the switch to the single European currency in 1999.
The board supported efforts to develop alliances with partners in other time zones in America and in Asia to deal with a global market in euros.
A MATIF statement said the strategy for development would follow the following three aims:
-- the whole range of existing franc products to be adapted
-- products in euros to be created to cover all maturities on the yield curve
-- a reduction in costs of market access.
